title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
summaryZh: 我們是先知的後裔，承受了傳遞神靈與神話語的產業，因此我們口中當宣告神的話語。
ref: 以賽亞書 59; 使徒行傳 3
lines: Isaiah 59, we got three more verses, so hold tight here.
以賽亞書59章，我們還有三節經文，所以請大家堅持一下。
Isaiah 59, we'll do the next two real quick, so get your gospel track shoes on and let's fly.
以賽亞書59章，我們會很快地看接下來的兩節，所以穿上你們的『福音田徑鞋』，我們要起飛了。
Isaiah 60 is, if you've been here a while, you know that it's one of my most favorite chapters because it changed my life.
以賽亞書60章，如果你在這裡待過一段時間，你會知道那是我最喜歡的篇章之一，因為它改變了我的生命。
"Arise, shine, your light has come," that whole passage I believe with all of my heart is a prophetic word for the church right now.
「興起，發光！因為你的光已經來到」，我全心相信整段經文是現在給教會的先知性話語。
But preceding that, the last verse of chapter 59 sets the stage.
但在那之前，59章的最後一節奠定了基礎。
"As for me," says the Lord, "this is my covenant with them:
「至於我」，耶和華說，「與他們所立的約乃是這樣：
My Spirit who is upon you, and my words which I have put in your mouth, shall not depart from your mouth,
我加給你的靈，傳給你的話，必不離你的口，
nor from the mouth of your descendants, nor from the mouth of your descendants' descendants," says the Lord, "from this time and forever."
也不離你後裔與你後裔之後裔的口」，這是耶和華說的，「從今直到永遠。」
Please notice again the correlation between the Spirit of God coming upon people and the word of the Lord being in their mouth.
請再次注意神的靈降臨在人身上，與神的話語在他們口中，兩者之間的關聯。
The evidence that the Spirit of God is resting upon us as a people, as a tribe, as a family, must be...
神的靈停留在我們這群人、這個部落、這個家庭身上的證據，一定是...
You know how much I love the healing, the miracles, the deliverance, all those things.
你們知道我有多喜歡醫治、神蹟、釋放，以及這一切的事。
...it must be that from our mouth comes the word of the Lord.
...那證據一定就是，從我們口中會說出神的話語。
Jesus set a standard when he said, "I only say what I hear my Father say."
耶穌設立了一個標準，當祂說：「我只說我聽見我父所說的。」
If there's anybody that ever walked the earth that probably would have some pretty good ideas on his own, it would probably be Jesus.
如果世上有誰可能靠自己就有很棒的想法，那大概就是耶穌了。
But he was unwilling to come up with anything of his own.
但祂不願意憑自己想出任何東西。
The Gospel of John says, "He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory."
約翰福音說：「憑著自己說的人，是求自己的榮耀。」
He who speaks from himself, in other words, it all originates with me, seeks his own glory.
憑著自己說的人，換句話說，也就是「這一切都源自我」的人，是在求自己的榮耀。
In other words, us unwilling to tap into what the Father is saying is a subtle way to move into self-promotion.
換句話說，我們若不願意去汲取天父所說的話，這其實是一種變相自我推銷的微妙方式。
Acts chapter 3, another real quick one.
使徒行傳第3章，另一個很快的經文。
Acts chapter 3, this is a great prophetic passage.
使徒行傳第3章，這是一段很棒的先知性經文。
After the outpouring of the Spirit in chapter 2, verse 24 says,
在第2章聖靈澆灌之後，第24節說：
"Yes, all the prophets, from Samuel and those who follow, as many as have spoken, have also foretold these days."
「從撒母耳以來的眾先知，凡說預言的，也都說到這些日子。」
"You are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers,
「你們是先知的子孫，也承受神與我們祖宗所立的約，
saying to Abraham, 'And in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.'"
就是對亞伯拉罕說：地上萬族都要因你的後裔得福。」
"You are the sons of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers,
「你們是先知的子孫，也承受神與我們祖宗所立的約，
saying to Abraham, 'In your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.'"
就是對亞伯拉罕說：地上萬族都要因你的後裔得福。」
This passage, Isaiah 59, was a passage given to the nation of Israel, but prophetically foretold the nation of the redeemed, which is the church.
以賽亞書59章這段經文，是給以色列國的，但它先知性地預言了被救贖的國度，也就是教會。
All right, but this one is clearly to the body of Christ.
好的，但這一段清楚是給基督的身體。
If you miss 59, this one for certain is to the body of Christ,
如果你錯過了59章，這一段絕對是給基督身體的，
in which he says, "You are the sons of the prophets, you are the daughters of the prophets."
神在其中說：「你們是先知的兒子，你們是先知的女兒。」
Because of the covenant established that I will put my word in your mouth, in your descendants' mouth, and in your descendants' descendants' mouth.
因為神立的約說，我會把我的話放在你的口中、你後裔的口中，以及你後裔之後裔的口中。
The whole point is that a distinguishing feature of being in the tribe of God,
重點在於，身為神部落的一份子，有一個顯著的特徵，
who is carrying his heartbeat into the earth, is that he has put his Spirit upon us,
就是將祂的心意帶到這世上，這特徵是祂已將祂的靈降臨在我們身上，
manifested by every generation being able to carry and declare the word of the Lord.
並彰顯於每一個世代都能夠承載，並宣告神的話語。
Acts chapter 3 says, "You're the sons, you're the daughters of the prophets."
使徒行傳第3章說：「你們是先知的兒子，你們是先知的女兒。」
In other words, you have an inheritance.
換句話說，你們有一份產業。
It's important for us to know what inheritance is.
我們必須知道這份產業是什麼。
It's important for us to discover what God says about us,
我們必須去發掘神對我們的宣告，
because you're not going to write a check if you don't think you have the money in the bank.
因為如果你不認為自己銀行裡有錢，你就不會去開支票。
You're not going to withdraw from identity if you don't realize it exists.
如果你不知道這身分的存在，你就不會從中支取。
You're not going to live from something that is far above everything you could imagine, unless he reveals that's who you are.
除非祂向你啟示這就是你的身分，否則你無法活出那遠超過你所求所想的生命。
Once you realize who you are, your posture changes.
一旦你明白你是誰，你的姿態就會改變。
It's not arrogant, it's not self-centered, it's not even self-confidence.
這不是傲慢，不是自我中心，甚至不是自信。
It's a confidence in who God has pronounced you to be.
這是一種對神所宣告你的身分的信心。
And God says you are the sons, the daughters of the prophets.
而神說你是先知的兒子，先知的女兒。
Because of that, you're in line for an inheritance to carry the Spirit of God and the word of the Lord.
正因如此，你具備繼承產業的資格，能承載神的靈與神的話語。
有可能獲得，有資格得到
They are one and the same.
Jesus is the Word made flesh.
So the presence of God is the same as the voice of God.
所以神的同在，就等同於神的聲音。
Whenever you sense the presence, the voice is in the presence.
每當你感覺到神的同在，神的聲音就在這同在裡。
Whenever you hear the voice, the voice represents the face.
每當你聽見神的聲音，這聲音就代表了祂的面容。
